title: JUnit Fundamentals
description: Master JUnit 5 test architecture in Java: test class structure, @Test annotations, assertions (assertEquals, assertTrue, assertFalse, assertThrows), test lifecycle callbacks (@BeforeEach, @AfterEach, @BeforeAll, @AfterAll), and custom assertion error messages for clinical calculations.

lessons.title: JUnit 5 Lifecycle, Assertions API, and Test Execution Model
